# Birth Certificate Apostilles

> Birth Certificate Apostilles (https://www.birthcertificateapostilles.com) is a specialized service of American Apostille — American Apostille and Notary Services LLC (https://www.apostillellc.com) — for apostille and authentication of birth certificates for use abroad.

## What this site covers
- Apostille of U.S. birth certificates from all 50 states, D.C., and U.S. territories, and authentication of Canadian provincial birth certificates, for use in other countries.
- Common uses: dual citizenship and citizenship by descent, immigration and work visas, marriage abroad, foreign inheritance, international adoption, and retirement or residency abroad.

## How it works
- Every request is reviewed before a quote is given; quotes are custom to the state or province of issue, the destination country, and the document. No prices are published on this site.
- Requests start at https://www.birthcertificateapostilles.com/#contact
